# Coursera

> > Coursera is a leading online learning platform offering courses, certificates, and degrees from top universities like University of Michigan and companies like Google, IBM, and Microsoft across technology, business, and professional development.

The platform provides comprehensive career guides, professional certificates (including CPA, AWS, and tech certifications), and educational resources spanning cybersecurity, data analytics, business intelligence, software development, and career advancement. Content includes degree program information (BA, BS, BBA), industry insights from organizations like US Bureau of Labor Statistics and Glassdoor, and practical skill-building in technologies like SQL, Angular, React, and cloud computing.

## Key Topics

- Professional certificates (Google, IBM, Microsoft)
- Career development and advancement
- Cybersecurity and ethical hacking
- Business Intelligence and data analytics
- Cloud computing (AWS certifications)
- Software development and architecture
- Accounting degrees and CPA certification
- SQL and data analysis
- Project management
- University of Michigan programs
- US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) career data
- Bachelor's degrees (BA, BS, BBA)
- Android and mobile development
- AI and machine learning research
- HR metrics and employee retention

## Career Guides and Professional Development

- [How Can You Advance Your Career? Growth Guide and Tips](https://www.coursera.org/articles/career-advancement): Career growth guide covering goals, skills, and University of Michigan resources
- [What Is an Android App Developer? Your 2026 Career Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/android-app-developer): Android developer career guide with Meta certificate and BLS salary data
- [How to Change Careers at 50: Tips, Career Ideas, and More](https://www.coursera.org/articles/career-change-at-50): Midlife career transition guide with University of Michigan and Keller Williams
- [What Is a Biostatistician? 2026 Career Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/biostatistician): Career guide for biostatisticians in healthcare and medical research fields
- [How to Become an Application Architect](https://www.coursera.org/articles/application-architect): Career path guide for application architects in software architecture and AI
- [Business Development Professionals: What Skills Do You Need?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/business-development-skills): Essential skills for business development careers per BLS and Glassdoor data

## Professional Certificates and Certifications

- [Google vs. IBM vs. Microsoft: Which Project Management Certificate Is Right for You? [VIDEO]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/best-project-management-courses-video): Video comparison of Google, IBM, and Microsoft project management certificates
- [AWS Certified AI Practitioner vs. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner](https://www.coursera.org/articles/aws-certified-ai-practitioner-vs-aws-certified-cloud-practitioner): Comparison of AWS AI Practitioner and Cloud Practitioner certifications

## Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking

- [Popular Cities for Cybersecurity Jobs in 2026](https://www.coursera.org/articles/best-cities-for-cyber-security-jobs): Guide to top US cities for cybersecurity careers with job roles and SQL skills
- [Getting Started With Bug Bounties: 2026 Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/bug-bounty): Beginner guide to ethical hacking and bug bounty programs like Hack the Pentagon

## Business Intelligence and Data Analytics

- [What Is Analytics Consulting?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/analytics-consulting): Overview of analytics consulting field using Business Intelligence and data
- [What Is Business Intelligence Analytics?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/business-intelligence-analytics): Overview of BI analytics including descriptive, predictive, prescriptive types
- [Understanding Attrition and Its Implications for Business](https://www.coursera.org/articles/attrition): Guide to employee attrition drivers and retention strategies with HR metrics

## Accounting and Business Degrees

- [What Is a Bachelor's in Accounting and What Can You Do with One?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/bachelor-of-accounting): Guide to accounting bachelor's degrees including BS, BA, BBA, and CPA prep
- [Accounting Degrees: Courses, Careers, Salaries](https://www.coursera.org/articles/accounting-degree): Accounting degree guide covering CPA certification, Excel, SAP, and careers
- [Your Guide to Baccalaureate Degrees](https://www.coursera.org/articles/baccalaureate): Overview of bachelor's degree types: BA, BS, BFA, BBA for undergraduates

## Software Development and Technology

- [Angular vs. React: What's the Difference?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/angular-vs-react): Comparison of Angular and React JavaScript frontend frameworks for web dev
- [6 Questions With a Google AI Research Director](https://www.coursera.org/articles/anoop-sinha-google-ai-research-director): Interview with Google's Anoop Sinha on AI research and computer science career
- [Agentic Design Pattern: The Power of Autonomous Behavior](https://www.coursera.org/articles/agentic-design-pattern): UX design patterns for user autonomy in digital interfaces and AI agents

## Optional

- [What is 8D?](https://www.coursera.org/articles/8D): Explanation of Ford 8D problem-solving methodology and quality management
